note: Linear ENPRVN is the source of truth for dates. Notion is the operating picture. Do not journal Architecture, RACI, or the playbook on a daily pass.

passes.label: Release window
passes.when: Copy playbook checklists into Linear — do not edit the playbook body

passes.label: Process
passes.when: Only when the way of working changed

items.title: Log blockers from Daily
items.what: New Issue/Risk if it threatens a date or needs PdM/CS/DTP. CS/DTP/SCM reports become Linear bugs the same day.
items.fields: Type, Status, Mitigation, Due, Owner, Impact

items.title: Touch projects only if phase moved
items.what: Do not rewrite Notes every standup. Update when blocked, entered QA, or the date slipped.
items.fields: Status, RAG, Target Date, Notes (one line)

items.title: WIP and bugs live in Linear first
items.what: Ticket state, project target, comments. Notion snapshots Linear.

items.title: Refresh RAG before PdM 1:1
items.what: RAG = can we hit the Linear date given open High RAID. Thursday after refinement.
items.fields: RAG, Status, Target Date, Owner, Notes

items.title: Walk Open items
items.what: High + due dates. No reply by SLA → escalate in PdM 1:1 (acting PO: k.kuno / s.nonaka).

items.title: Thursday refinement notes
items.what: Scope, AC, splits. DoR on QA Hub must hold before a story enters sprint. Not Slack-only.

items.title: Capacity vs Linear projects
items.what: PD / PdM / PjM weekly assignment. This app is the working board; Notion resource page is the docs pointer. Then run linear-enprvn-sync if actuals are stale.

items.title: Update Plan / Env / Gap if coverage changed
items.what: Only when BDD/manual coverage or env changed (flake, new epic, DC still no suite).

items.title: Retro every 2 weeks (Thursday)
items.what: KPT, close/open sprint, FE/BE estimates. Skip on non-review Thursdays.
items.fields: Retro notes; sprint plan in Linear

items.title: YYYY-MM released features page
items.what: After every silent or public prod ship. Month-end: complete the child page.
items.fields: Child page YYYY-MM — Tính năng đã release

items.title: Mark shipped epics Done
items.what: Status Done when hypercare ends. Do not leave shipped work as QA.
items.fields: Status Done; Notes = ship date + silent/public

items.title: Close stale Watching / mitigated risks
items.what: Keep standing issues honest (PO vacant, shared-service assumptions).

items.title: Review Accepted ADRs
items.what: Mark Deprecated/Superseded if practice changed. Do not rewrite Accepted history.
items.fields: Status only, unless adding a new ADR

items.title: Ceremonies, RACI, named seats
items.what: Update when the team changes how it works, not every sprint.

items.title: Service map / deploy owner / env
items.what: Update when a repo, pipeline, or owner changes. QA3 = VN verify; QA1 = stakeholder staging.
items.fields: Service map, Repos table, Env table

items.title: People, channels, language, SLA
items.what: Update when aliases or acting-PO change.

items.title: QA strategy / severity / DoR / DoD
items.what: Ticket-level DoD lives on Linear. Touch strategy only when policy changes.
items.fields: Owners, Test strategy, Bug triage, DoR/DoD

items.title: Generic DoR/DoD wording
items.what: EVN-specific lists are on the QA Hub. Touch if tracker wording drifts (Jira vs Linear).

items.title: New ADR the same day
items.what: A decision others must follow. Not a substitute for meeting notes.
items.fields: Name, Status, Area, Decision, Owner, Decided

releaseTemplates.title: T-10 — freeze scope and invite QA
releaseTemplates.what: Release ticket exists. CS/SCM/DTP invited. Target on Linear and Current Projects. RAID reviewed.

releaseTemplates.title: T-5 — Dev QA and consumers
releaseTemplates.what: Dev QA done. Backward-compat. Order Hub / IHA / catalog / DM ops checked.

releaseTemplates.title: T-3 — PdM/CS QA and FAQ draft
releaseTemplates.what: Use the matrix as a ping list. Do not edit the matrix page. FAQ / release note draft ready.

releaseTemplates.title: T-1 Go/No-Go
releaseTemplates.what: No High RAID without mitigation. Rollback owner named. Silent vs public decided (Decision Log if new). Comms drafted.

releaseTemplates.title: T-0 deploy and T+1–5 hypercare
releaseTemplates.what: Slack release thread. Watch CS tickets → RAID issues. Add the feature to the YYYY-MM child page.
